title: Read Voltage
description: Reads the voltage on an analog input of an IO device (ADC) into a float variable, in volts.
activation: Runs every pass while enabled; to sample at a fixed rate, put a Periodic block tick on Run when.

voltage.title: Voltage
voltage.description: Voltage on the pin, in volts.

eno.title: Read
eno.description: True when the pin was read and the Voltage written this pass.
